# Encyclopedia.com

> > Comprehensive reference encyclopedia covering biographies, science, medicine, history, literature, and cultural topics across all disciplines and time periods.

Encyclopedia.com provides authoritative articles spanning notable figures like John Jacob Abel and Chinua Achebe, scientific topics from biochemistry to pharmacology, historical subjects including the Caliphate and regional planning movements, and cultural references from Greek mythology to musical instruments. The encyclopedia draws from reputable sources to offer detailed entries on people, places, concepts, and phenomena across human knowledge.

## Key Topics

- Biography and notable figures
- Biochemistry and pharmacology
- 19th-century medicine and medical scientists
- African literature and postcolonial fiction
- Town planning and regional planning
- Islamic history and the Caliphate
- Colonial and postcolonial literature
- American scientists and inventors
- European history and geography
- Medical conditions and pathology
- Greek mythology and folklore
- Musical instruments and performing arts
- Anthropology and cultural customs
- Chemistry fundamentals
- Botanical and zoological sciences

## Notable Biographies

- [Chinua Achebe](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/literature-and-arts/miscellaneous-english-literature-20th-cent-biographies/chinua-achebe): Nigerian novelist Chinua Achebe biography, author of Things Fall Apart
- [James Naismith](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/sports-and-games/sports-biographies/james-naismith): Basketball inventor James Naismith biography (1861-1939)
- [John Jacob Abel](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/medicine/medicine-biographies/john-jacob-abel): Biography of pharmacologist John Jacob Abel (1857-1938)
- [Sir Patrick Abercrombie](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/literature-and-arts/architecture-biographies/sir-patrick-abercrombie): British architect and town-planner Patrick Abercrombie (1879-1957)
- [Sir Patrick Geddes](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/social-sciences-and-law/sociology-biographies/sir-patrick-geddes): Scottish sociologist and town planner Patrick Geddes (1854-1932)
- [Lady Augusta Gregory](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/literature-and-arts/english-literature-20th-cent-present-biographies/lady-augusta-gregory): Irish dramatist Lady Augusta Gregory and Abbey Theatre co-founder
- [Creighton Williams Abrams](https://www.encyclopedia.com/people/history/us-history-biographies/creighton-williams-abrams): General Creighton W. Abrams WWII tank commander and Vietnam War leader

## Science and Medicine

- [Acids And Bases](https://www.encyclopedia.com/science-and-technology/chemistry/chemistry-general/acids-and-bases): Chemistry reference on acids, bases, and pH indicators

## History and Culture

- [Caliphate](https://www.encyclopedia.com/history/asia-and-africa/middle-eastern-history/caliphate): Islamic caliphate history and succession from Muhammad to 1924
- [Marriage](https://www.encyclopedia.com/social-sciences-and-law/anthropology-and-archaeology/customs-and-artifacts/marriage): Anthropological analysis of marriage, family formation, and kinship
- [Bollandists](https://www.encyclopedia.com/philosophy-and-religion/christianity/roman-catholic-orders-and-missions/bollandists): Jesuit scholars Bollandists and their hagiography work Acta Sanctorum
